_comment: Rules of skill build-dcf-model. A rule computes only if its status is VERIFIED-REOPENED or ENGINEERING RULE; a [CHECK] rule is disabled and the script prints [CHECK].

rules.passage: In developing a discount rate, the valuer must document the method used and provide evidence for the derivation of the discount rate.
The capitalisation or discount rate applied must be consistent with the type of income or cash flow used.
The terminal value is then discounted back to the valuation date, normally using the same discount rate as applied to the forecast cash flow.
no registered threshold for a terminal-value share

rules.reason: operating cash flow = net revenue x (1 - cogs% - opex%) - fixed costs, less tax on the positive part, capex and working capital; no loss carry-forward
rules.gap: no standard prescribes this cash-flow construction for a development-stage asset; WIPO describes sales growing from a low base, peaking and declining (VP-V-009)
